heading: derived from canonical metric positions; gaze is retained only as source information
homography_note: The raw archives omit H.txt. Light-weight matrices from the pinned OpenTraj release are committed in src/datasets_preprocessing/ucy/homographies.json.
membership_note: All seven sequences are canonical and used for publication characterization. canonical_recordings is intentionally the independent four-sequence Social-GAN forecasting benchmark membership.
area_source: per-recording occupancy-grid effective area using the scale-free observed-mass rule configured by src/stats.py

heading_provenance.meaning: Direction of travel (course-over-ground), not body/sensor orientation.
heading_provenance.computed_from: central-difference of interpolated canonical x/y (src/heading.py::central_difference_heading), computed after homography projection.
